Codex hook inputs, built from the generated schemas in openai/codex
(`codex-rs/hooks/schema/generated/{stop,session-start}.command.input.schema.json`, every required
field present) and the docs (https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks). Not recorded from a live run.
The tests replace `__CWD__` and `__MESSAGE__`; ids, model and paths are made up.
